records.name: Whole Milk
records.description: Milk containing its naturally occurring milk fat.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; raw/dry unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides vitamin B12 and other micronutrients.
cautions: People with milk allergy should avoid it.
servingSuggestions: Drink plain or use in cooking.
selectionTips: Choose pasteurized milk from a reliable source and check expiry.

records.name: Low-Fat Milk
records.description: Milk with some milk fat removed.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; raw/dry unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides protein and calcium with less fat than whole milk.
cautions: Milk allergy or lactose intolerance may require alternatives.
servingSuggestions: Use as a drink or in cooking.

records.description: Fermented milk product made using cultures.

selectionTips: Choose plain refrigerated curd with a clean smell and valid expiry.

records.description: Fresh acid-set cheese widely used in Indian cooking.

selectionTips: Choose fresh paneer with clean aroma and firm texture.
